name: Kugutsu Asuka
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c15017]Souchi[/url]'s niece and [url=https://vndb.org/c15016]Haruka[/url]'s oldest daughter. She is a very kind and affectionate person, she is the living image of her mother when she was younger.

[spoiler] When she was a child she found her mom's memory box keeping mementos and love letters that her uncle gave to her at the time they were a couple. After reading those letters she fell in love with her uncle believing she was born to be his wife. [/spoiler]
